New Release Grouping Examines Extraterrestrial Intelligence, Hidden Histories, and Planetary Computers

  • Screenshot 20260809 080320 2

Denver, Colorado Sep 2, 2026 (Issuewire.com)  - Dex System Publishing today announced a new speculative press release grouping centered on cosmic mysteries, alien conspiracies, and hidden paranormal truths. Diving deep into fringe theories and high-concept science fiction, this collection pairs two standing anchor titles with three provocative books that question the origins of human consciousness and planetary manipulation.

Featured Titles in This Release

  • E+Drive: The Good Ghost (A Tale of Choice) by Ronald Bartholomew (Anchor Title) A cornerstone narrative exploring agency, decision-making, and the ethical boundaries of ghost-in-the-machine systems.  https://www.amazon.com/Drive-Good-Ghost-Tale-Choice/dp/B0H34SSCBV/
  • Portals by Chester Craig (Anchor Title) A speculative voyage through threshold dimensions, digital conduits, and connected realms.  https://www.amazon.com/Portals-Chester-Craig/dp/B0GZ55G47K/
  • Echoes of the Machine: Humanity's Programmed Past by Blake Edwards An investigative narrative postulating that human civilization is built upon an ancient, artificial substrate.  https://www.amazon.com/Echoes-Machine-Humanitys-Programmed-Past/dp/B0GVQ3NW9V/
  • Venus Rising: The Galactic Conspiracy Within by Marvin Hamner A thrilling story of secret societies, interplanetary agendas, and the truth hidden beneath our closest neighbor.  https://www.amazon.com/Venus-Rising-Galactic-Conspiracy-Within/dp/B0F23C82D3/
  • Whispers from the Stars: The Starborn Reptiles' Planetary Computer by Blake Edwards A mind-bending sci-fi exploration of cosmic architects steering Earth via hidden megastructures. Amazon | Books2Read https://www.amazon.com/Whispers-Stars-Starborn-Reptiles-Planetary/dp/B0F77X3B6K/

Where Myth Meets Extraterrestrial Logic

This collection highlights Dex System Publishing's devotion to high-concept speculative storytelling that pushes past traditional genre limits. By blending paranormal intrigue with technological conspiratorial lore, these titles challenge readers to look up at the stars—and question what lies beneath their feet.

Media Availability & Review Copies

Digital review copies, author interview scheduling, and media kit assets are available upon request for media outlets, reviewers, and industry analysts.

About Dex System Publishing

Dex System Publishing, under the AM I AM imprint, is an AI-powered creative publishing operation producing and promoting a multi-genre catalog. Titles are distributed through the Cipher Grid digital hub.
